# First Call?

![First Call? function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/synchronization/first-call.svg)

[Synchronization functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Detects this node's first effective passage in its execution instance. Returns True once, then False during the same active caller cycle. No wait or initialization is performed. Unvisited branches do not consume the state; loop re-entry and pause/resume do not reset it. Shared active callers retain the same state until all release the instance; independent data spaces remain independent. This result does not mean that another branch has completed initialization.

Consumes the first-passage state for this node in the actual execution data-space and active caller cycle. True on the first effective evaluation, then False. Unvisited regions do not consume it; pause/resume and inner-loop re-entry do not reset it. Shared active callers keep the same cycle until the last caller releases it; independent data spaces have independent state. This is not an initialization-completion barrier.
